functions.description: Parse base Envoy log structure: timestamp, host, sub-component, optional severity, and message
Extract src/dst address:port for accepted TCP connections
Extract HTTP request method, url, client address:port and response status
Extract user and client address:port for failed authentication events

add.name: action
add.value: message && message.startsWith('Accepted') ? 'accepted' : message && message.startsWith('Authentication failed') ? 'denied' : message && message.startsWith('Request') ? 'completed' : severity === 'Error' ? 'error' : severity === 'Warning' ? 'warning' : 'info'

functions.description: Normalize IP fields (strip IPv6 brackets), set protocol/action/severity/direction, and clean up scratch fields

add.name: dest_ip

add.name: dest_port
add.value: dest_port || dst_port || destination__port || dpt || dstport || dport

add.name: log_time
add.value: log_time || generated_time || receive_time || start_time || event__created || timestamp || event__start

functions.description: Alias Copilot/schematizer OCSF-style fields to canonical names

add.name: _time
add.value: (typeof log_time != 'undefined' && log_time) ? (/^\d{13}$/.test(String(log_time)) ? Number(log_time) : /^\d{10}$/.test(String(log_time)) ? Number(log_time) * 1000 : /^\d{13}\.\d+$/.test(String(log_time)) ? Number(log_time) : /^\d{10}\.\d+$/.test(String(log_time)) ? Number(log_time) * 1000 : new Date(String(log_time)).getTime()) / 1000 : _time
